summary: PyYAML < 5.4 allows arbitrary code execution via full_load/FullLoader on untrusted YAML.
requests < 2.31.0 may leak Proxy-Authorization headers to destination servers on redirect.
Flask < 2.2.5 can cache session cookies on shared proxies (missing Vary: Cookie).
Werkzeug < 2.2.3 multipart parser can be abused for resource exhaustion (DoS).
Jinja2 < 3.1.3: xmlattr filter accepts keys with spaces, enabling HTML attribute injection (XSS).
Pillow < 10.0.1 bundles a libwebp version with a heap buffer overflow.
urllib3 < 1.26.5 is vulnerable to ReDoS when parsing URLs with many '@' characters.
lodash < 4.17.21 template function allows command injection.
minimist < 1.2.6 is vulnerable to prototype pollution.
